notes: A start and finish read from the teleport graph (chk-maps run 85). The spawn room floor is a 1200x1200 teleport to `spawn`, where the course starts; stages stage1_1..stage9_2 follow, and a 64x64 teleport over the last booster sends to `end`, the room whose trigger marks the finisher. Not published.

conditional_teleports.note: The anti-standing trap: touching a block renames the player `activator` after 0.09 s and back to `default` after 0.1 s; the teleports behind filter_activator fire only on that name. Run as sinking blocks.
